title: Closing a neighbourhood crossing consultation
titleZh: 寄出行人穿越道諮詢報告前

To: Neighbourhood consultation volunteers

Subject: Before we send the crossing report

We promised the ward office two figures: the number of households that took part and the number of submissions giving a preference for one of the crossing designs. The first figure counts each household only once; the second counts each eligible form with a named design, including more than one eligible form from the same household.

Before the consultation closed last night, our office received a completed postcard from the public meeting. It said, “I cannot choose without a diagram showing the evening bus stop.” The household was not yet listed in the participation register, and its address was within the consultation area. For the report, make [131] _____. Keep the postcard itself in the remarks packet.

Four of the consultation information packs were returned undelivered. The building manager has given us current addresses for those households. At those addresses, we can send the diagram and design notes today, without the original reply card. [132] _____ If a resident asks whether a new response will appear in the report, explain that the figures cover only replies already in our office at last night’s cutoff.

One more note about the paper packet: if a postcard names a design and also gives a reason, retain a copy after entering the preference. Without that copy, we could reproduce the choice from the table, [133] _____. Put a dated cover sheet on the packet, then attach the packet [134] _____ the report before sending it to the ward office.

收件人：社區諮詢志工

主旨：寄出行人穿越道諮詢報告前

我們答應向區公所提供兩項數字：參與諮詢的戶數，以及明確偏好某個穿越道設計方案的回覆份數。前者每戶只計一次；後者計入每份符合資格、指明方案的表單，即使同一戶交回不只一份也照計。

昨晚諮詢截止前，辦公室收到一張在公開會議上填妥的明信片。上面寫著：「如果沒有標出晚間公車站位置的圖，我無法選擇。」這一戶尚未列入參與戶名冊，地址也在諮詢區內。請在報告中作以下調整：[131] _____。明信片本身請留在書面意見資料中。

有四份諮詢資料包因無法投遞被退回。大樓管理員已提供這四戶的現址。我們今天可以把圖示與設計說明寄到這些地址，但不附原本的回覆卡。[132] _____。若住戶問新的回覆是否會列入報告，請說明數字只涵蓋昨晚截止時已送達辦公室的回覆。

紙本資料還有一個注意事項：若明信片既選擇了方案也寫了理由，輸入選項後請留一份副本。若不留副本，我們雖然能從統計表看出選了哪個方案，[133] _____。請在資料上加註明日期的封面，再將該份資料附[134] _____報告上，然後把報告寄給區公所。

To: Neighbourhood consultation volunteers

Subject: Before we send the crossing report

We promised the ward office two figures: the number of households that took part and the number of submissions giving a preference for one of the crossing designs. The first figure counts each household only once; the second counts each eligible form with a named design, including more than one eligible form from the same household.

Before the consultation closed last night, our office received a completed postcard from the public meeting. It said, “I cannot choose without a diagram showing the evening bus stop.” The household was not yet listed in the participation register, and its address was within the consultation area. For the report, make one addition to the household total and none to the preference total. Keep the postcard itself in the remarks packet.

Four of the consultation information packs were returned undelivered. The building manager has given us current addresses for those households. At those addresses, we can send the diagram and design notes today, without the original reply card. The replacement packs are for residents’ records. If a resident asks whether a new response will appear in the report, explain that the figures cover only replies already in our office at last night’s cutoff.

One more note about the paper packet: if a postcard names a design and also gives a reason, retain a copy after entering the preference. Without that copy, we could reproduce the choice from the table, but we could not include the reasons in the report packet. Put a dated cover sheet on the packet, then attach the packet to the report before sending it to the ward office.

收件人：社區諮詢志工

主旨：寄出行人穿越道諮詢報告前

我們答應向區公所提供兩項數字：參與諮詢的戶數，以及明確偏好某個穿越道設計方案的回覆份數。前者每戶只計一次；後者計入每份符合資格、指明方案的表單，即使同一戶交回不只一份也照計。

昨晚諮詢截止前，辦公室收到一張在公開會議上填妥的明信片。上面寫著：「如果沒有標出晚間公車站位置的圖，我無法選擇。」這一戶尚未列入參與戶名冊，地址也在諮詢區內。請在報告中作以下調整：參與戶數加一，方案偏好份數不變。明信片本身請留在書面意見資料中。

有四份諮詢資料包因無法投遞被退回。大樓管理員已提供這四戶的現址。我們今天可以把圖示與設計說明寄到這些地址，但不附原本的回覆卡。補寄的資料是供住戶留存之用。若住戶問新的回覆是否會列入報告，請說明數字只涵蓋昨晚截止時已送達辦公室的回覆。

紙本資料還有一個注意事項：若明信片既選擇了方案也寫了理由，輸入選項後請留一份副本。若不留副本，我們雖然能從統計表看出選了哪個方案，卻無法在報告附件中附上選擇該方案的理由。請在資料上加註明日期的封面，將該份資料附在報告上，再把報告寄給區公所。
